items.docs: Configure a trigger by passing the app identifier, action identifier, and labels through the payload.

Create an event by passing the app identifier, action identifier, and data through the payload. This endpoint provides a concise response with key parameters.

This API is available in Orchestrate v3.5.9 onwards.

params.name: title
params.description: Pass the keyword to search for in the titles of triggered events.

params.name: app_identifier
params.description: Pass the source app to filter events based on the apps.

params.name: action_identifier
params.description: Pass the event type to filter events based on the type of the event.

params.name: q
params.description: Pass the keyword to search in title (event title), `app_identifier` (source app), `action_identifer` (event type) and `unique_id` (event ID).

params.name: unique_id
params.description: Pass the unique ID of the event.

params.name: page
params.description: Pass the page number to retrieve the source event list.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Pass the number of items to retrieve per page.

params.name: labels
params.description: Pass the label name to filter the results.

params.name: create__lte
params.description: Pass the custom date in Unix timestamp format. The list of source events modified earlier than the entered time will be returned. Example: *1655231399*.

params.name: created__gte
params.description: Pass the custom date in Unix timestamp format. The list of source events modified after the entered time will be returned. Example: *1655145000*.

params.name: created
params.description: Pass the values for the time duration to view source events.

params.name: field
params.description: Pass the column name for which file will be generated. You can retrieve the column name in the `splitted_columns` field of the **Get Source Event Details** endpoint.

params.name: unique_id
params.description: Pass the unique ID of the event to download. You can retrieve the unique ID of the event using the **Get Source Events** endpoint.

params.name: event_unique_id
